title: Equal but not the same
hints: `Hashtag('#Python') == Hashtag('#python')` is `True`. Now compare `hash()` of the same two objects.
Sets and dicts look up the hash first and only call `__eq__` on keys with a matching hash. `__hash__` uses the raw text while `__eq__` ignores case, so equal tags end up in different buckets.
Hash the same normalised value `__eq__` compares: `return hash(self.text.casefold())`.
